page: OVHcloud b2-15 is a general-purpose virtual server hosted on a KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Haswell processor with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs running at 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 15.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB of RAM per core, and is bundled with 100 GB of local SSD storage. The CPU includes 16 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX, AES, and FMA instruction sets, though it lacks AVX-512 and TSX extensions.

Performance benchmarks place this server in the lower-to-average tiers. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is in the bottom 10% with a score of 959.69, while multi-core performance falls in the bottom 25% at 3669.99. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is average at 347.69 GB/sec, but drops to a weak 37.17 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Database operations and Redis SET performance are average, with Redis achieving 5.93 million operations per second. LLM inference speeds are average for small 135M models but poor for medium 7B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the b2-15 offers a balanced resource density of dedicated CPU cores and memory for entry-level general-purpose workloads without the premium of high-performance compute architectures. Given its moderate CPU performance and average database and memory benchmark results, this server is best suited for standard web serving, lightweight database operations, basic Redis caching, and general-purpose development or staging environments.
